$comment: Human-curated source for the Scholars and Saints tour (course krakow-scholars; docs/research/new-tours.md §3). Same format as royal-route.json: id, personaId, titles, summaries, fixedStartPoiId, fixedEndPoiId, estMinutes and per-stop poiId, dwellS, prize, triggerRadiusM, approachRadiusM mirror contracts/Model.ets Tour/TourStop; per-stop wikidataId, kind, names, lat, lng and view {look, feature} feed the Poi records. courseId names the course this tour is built into (scripts/pack/lib/course.mjs). Every other key is review metadata and is not emitted. All values are agent drafts until a human confirms them.

summaries.en: Learning and faith in Kraków's Old Town: from the college where Copernicus studied to the window where John Paul II talked to the crowds. 10 stops, about 2.2 km on foot.
summaries.pl: Nauka i wiara na krakowskim Starym Mieście: od kolegium, w którym studiował Kopernik, po okno, z którego Jan Paweł II rozmawiał z tłumami. 10 przystanków, około 2,2 km pieszo.
summaries.zh: 克拉科夫老城的学问与信仰之旅：从哥白尼求学的学院，到若望保禄二世向人群讲话的窗口。共10站，步行约2.2公里。

summariesReview: en drafted by the agent from docs/research/new-tours.md §3; pl and zh are agent drafts not yet checked by a native speaker
namesSource: Short display names curated for the app. pl: short local forms. zh: Wikidata zh labels (converted to simplified script, without the "(克拉科夫)" suffix) for stops 1-7; stops 8-10 have no zh label on Wikidata, so their zh names are agent drafts (docs/research/new-tours.md §3) that need a native check.
estMinutesBasis: OSRM foot, listed order, stop to stop: 2,242 m / 29.9 min (data/raw/tours/scholars-saints/osrm/stop-pairs-foot.json) + dwell 1290 s (21.5 min) = 51.4 min, rounded up.
coordinateMethod: lat/lng = Wikidata P625 (data/raw/wikidata/krakow-items.json.gz). Each stop is cross-checked against the centroid of the OSM element tagged with the same wikidata= in data/raw/osm/oldtown-tile*.osm.gz (way/relation: mean of the outline nodes). flag = more than 40 m apart (none).
radiiNote: Draft values for review. 35 m trigger radius everywhere (narrow Old Town streets), approachRadiusM 110 (ARCHITECTURE default). Every radius exceeds the stop's OSRM snap distance. Collegium Novum and the Copernicus Monument are about 37 m apart and St Anne's and Collegium Maius about 43 m, so their circles overlap; the engine arms only the next planned stop.
